title: 검은 항구의 밤 · TRPG 플레이 그래프 벤치마크

capabilities.entity_creation: explicit structured host input; unresolved Mention does not create or merge Entity

methodology.query_vectors: Live query embeddings batched once and reused; per-query runtime excludes that network latency. Decision requests remain live.
methodology.metrics: Support recall and stored directed path-node coverage measure evidence retrieval, not causal answer correctness. Minimal-gold precision may count useful extra context as non-gold.
methodology.entity_decisions: Session snapshots, candidate name/metadata only (production candidate contract). Model chooses existing candidate or unknown; never creates/resolves automatically.
methodology.negative_cases: Exclusion violations are diagnostic; read-only, Space and lifecycle checks are asserted.
